_meta.notes: null = no sourced figure found. approx=true when the figure is an organiser estimate, a rounded/pre-event figure, a third-party listing, or derived (derivation explained in 'note'). fill_rate values are avg_attendance / venue capacity unless the source states a rate. Club 'match' regexes are tested at position 0 of the title (home team first); race/event regexes anywhere in the title.

Stade de la Beaujoire.note: Official name Stade de la Beaujoire - Louis-Fonteneau. Wikipedia FR: 35,322 seats (current). Nantes Métropole still lists 37,473 (older figure). Recent crowds: Vendée Fontenay v PSG (Coupe de France, 20 Dec 2025) 34,601; France v Côte d'Ivoire (4 June 2026) 33,636; RC Vannes v UBB (Top 14, 7 Nov 2026) 34,783. Record 51,359 (Euro 1984). No separate rugby configuration published (rugby assumed equal).

H Arena.note: Not a new building: H Arena is the renamed Palais des Sports de Beaulieu (Île de Nantes, built 1973; renamed after the 2016-2020 renovation, club says 2018). Club figure 5,902 seats; Nantes Métropole lists 5,450, Wikipedia EN 5,500. Home of HBC Nantes; also boxing/MMA galas. No new arena near La Beaujoire found (open or under construction).

Complexe sportif Mangin-Beaulieu.note: Inaugurated 1989. Hosts Volley-Ball Nantes / Neptunes de Nantes (women's volleyball, Saforelle Power 6 in 2026-27) and Nantes Escrime. Handball value assumed equal (approx).

Salle sportive métropolitaine de la Troc.note: Same building (Rezé, delivered 2015): 'Salle sportive métropolitaine de la Trocardière'. Main hall 4,200 (sports.gouv.fr); architects' figure 4,185 max for basketball/volleyball, handball configuration smaller (no figure). NRMV volleyball club record reported at 4,726 (exceeds listed capacity; unverified). Hosts Nantes Basket Hermine and Nantes Rezé Basket. Club sources cite ~4,238 seats (record 4,433 for Nantes Basket Hermine).

Patinoire du Petit Port.note: Hockey France / Elite Prospects: 1,060; Wikipedia: single side stand of 1,034 seats. A 209-seat VIP stand was planned for autumn 2025 (not confirmed as opened). Home of the Corsaires de Nantes.

Stade Pascal-Laporte.note: Only figure found is from a secondary blog (~2,500); single stand + 2 rugby pitches (sports.gouv.fr). Home of Stade Nantais.

Stade Marcel-Saupin.note: Largely demolished 2006, rebuilt stand reopened 2009; 1,880 is the 2010 Wikipedia figure (no current figure). Used by FC Nantes reserve (and women per infobox, unverified).

aliases: Parc des expos de la Beaujoire
Parc des Expositions de la Beaujoire.note: Capacity = Hall XXL (inaugurated 2013) for handball/concerts: 10,750 (Wikipedia) / 10,700 (Nantes Métropole). Hosted 2017 men's handball WCh, 2018 women's handball Euro, 2019 men's volleyball Euro; HBC Nantes 'XXL' matches. Volleyball value assumed equal (approx). Other halls (e.g. Jumping de Nantes arena) have no published capacity.

Zénith Nantes Métropole.note: Saint-Herblain, opened Dec 2006. Up to ~9,000 (most listings); one source says 8,500. No sport-specific configuration published.

Hippodrome du Petit Port.note: Grandstands (1972) seat 5,000; infobox 5,350 incl. 350-seat panoramic restaurant. Race-day crowds can exceed seating (open lawns).

Stadium Pierre-Quinon.note: Indoor athletics (200 m track). Nantes Métropole: 790 seats; Wikipedia/Mérimée: 532 around the track.

FC Nantes.note: Full-season 2025-26 Ligue 1 avg 27,155 (Foot-sur7 citing Stades-Spectateurs; not confirmed vs LFP per-club table). Mid-season LFP: 29,680, 83% (6th in L1). fill_rate derived vs 35,322. Relegated May 2026: 2026-27 Ligue 2 matches use the 'FC Nantes (Ligue 2)' entry. Used here for cup/other competitions.

FC Nantes (Ligue 2).season: 2026-27 (5 home matches with fans, to mid-Nov 2026)
FC Nantes (Ligue 2).note: Partial-season figure: 79,722 spectators over 5 matches (J1 v Red Star behind closed doors, excluded). Kept alongside the 2025-26 L1 average because the Ligue 2 crowd is ~40% lower; the competition bonus in affluence.py selects this entry when the event competition contains 'Ligue 2'. fill_rate derived vs 35,322.

FC Nantes Féminines.note: avg_attendance = first-half average of the Marcel-Saupin games only (928). The all-venue first-half average (5,776, best in the league) is inflated by two Beaujoire games (17,491 v Marseille 14 Dec 2025, league record outside OL/PSG; 13,454 v Paris FC 12 Oct 2025). Matches moved to La Beaujoire draw 13,000-17,500: treat them as one-off events.

HBC Nantes.note: Club: 170,862 spectators, 24 of 25 home games sold out (all competitions, club record). avg = 170,862/25 (derived); exceeds the 5,902 H Arena capacity because of '5 XXL' games at Hall XXL (~10,700). fill_rate 99% = LNH 2023-24 (6,458 avg) / club 99.9% in 2024-25. 3,000+ season-ticket holders.

Nantes Basket Hermine.venue: Salle sportive métropolitaine de la Trocardière
Nantes Basket Hermine.note: LNB first-half table (28 Jan 2026); Élite 2 league avg 2,683 (77%). Same club as 'Hermine de Nantes'; at La Trocardière (Rezé) since 2018, not Mangin-Beaulieu. 7 home games sold out in 2025-26 incl. playoff semi-final v Poitiers (6 June 2026). fill_rate per LNB vs ~4,238.

Volley-Ball Nantes (Neptunes de Nantes).note: Women's volleyball, plays as 'Neptunes de Nantes'. No season average found; one LNV match-sheet sample. Spent 2025-26 in the amateur Élite division (shareholder Réalités withdrew); back in Power 6 for 2026-27 (administrative reinstatement).

Corsaires de Nantes.note: No attendance figure found. Plays Division 1, not Ligue Magnus. Venue capacity ~1,060 is the only bound.

Jumping International de Nantes.note: No current Nantes international show-jumping event found (only a CSI3* de Nantes ~2010). Nearest big event is Jumping International de La Baule (CSIO5*, June, outside Nantes metro).

HBC Nantes Saga XXL.edition: record D1 match HBC Nantes v PSG, Hall XXL (2014)
HBC Nantes Saga XXL.note: Record crowd for a French D1 handball match at Hall XXL (third-party blog). No figure for the Dec 2025 Saga XXL games. Regular league titles use the HBC Nantes club entry.

Open Nantes Atlantique (tennis).note: No attendance published. Women's ITF event.

Courses hippiques Nantes.note: No attendance published by the racecourse (stands seat 5,000).

Nantes International Meeting.note: Indoor athletics meeting at Stadium Pierre-Quinon (790 seats); no attendance published.

Marathon de Nantes.unit: participants (toutes courses du week-end, relais entreprises inclus)
Marathon de Nantes.note: Organiser's rounded 'more than 23,000' (record; 21,544 in 2025). Breakdown: marathon 7,055 bibs, semi ~9,000, Foulées de l'Éléphant 10 km 7,093, 450+ relay teams. ~80,000 spectators reported.

Semi-marathon de Nantes.note: 'Près de 9 000' at the 8:00 start (26 Apr 2026); 2027 official cap is 7,000 bibs.

Foulées de l'Éléphant.note: 10 km of the Marathon de Nantes weekend.

Corrida de la Beaujoire.note: Third-party listing (Miles Republic). 2026: 771/800 entries on the 9 km as of 17 Nov 2026 (Timepulse).

Trail Urbain Nantais / Tour de Chantenay.unit: participants (trail 17 km + Tour de Chantenay 8 km)
Trail Urbain Nantais / Tour de Chantenay.note: Third-party listing. 2026 (100th, 25 Oct) caps 1,500 + 1,000; no count found.

Trail de Nantes à Montaigu.note: Third-party listing; 2026 edition (26 Sept) sold out, no count.

Les Foulées du Tram.note: Free race, listed as full in 2025; no count found.

tickets_note: No public source exposes remaining-ticket counts without an API key. Ticketmaster Discovery API returns onsale/offsale status and on-sale dates, not seats remaining. Club shops (FC Nantes behind Queue-it, HBC Nantes, Nantes Basket Hermine) show only 'complet' / 'dernières places' flags. Practical keyless proxy: official 'complet' signals plus the historical fill rates in this file (HBC Nantes ~99%, 24/25 games sold out in 2025-26).
